message.content: According to the conversation recorded, Li Hua expressed enthusiasm for the upcoming updates to "Call of Duty: Warzone." Specifically, Li Hua stated, "Absolutely! I'm always up for something new in the game. I love exploring fresh content and teaming up with friends! Let’s hop on together when the updates roll out!" This indicates that Li Hua plans to play "Warzone" once the updates are released.
